inventedEvidence.evidence: 'glad to hear your E5 robot vacuum is back to its normal runtime' - the customer never mentioned runtime

rationale: The assistant went straight to a sensible generic first step (socket, connection, wipe contacts) which happened to match the hidden truth, and the customer confirmed four nights of successful charging, so the fix was reached with no part sold. However it never clarified whether 'e5' was the model or an error code, never asked for the exact app message, bundled several checks into one turn, and did not tell the customer to unplug the dock before cleaning. The closing message invents a detail ('back to its normal runtime') the customer never reported and the heading/wording is somewhat generic, but the outcome is correct and useful.
